Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer attempted to verify the birthplace by navigating to the IMDb page for Deva (composer) using the URL `https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0222148/`. However, this URL corresponds to "Jay Dee Daugherty," a completely different person, as evidenced by the page content showing his filmography (e.g., *P.O.V.*, *Ohne Maulkorb*). The WebSurfer failed to correctly identify or locate the specific IMDb ID for the Indian composer Deva (Devanesan Chokkalingam), leading to the retrieval of incorrect biographical data instead of the required information.
